# Horus Desk

Horus Desk is an operations-enablement company operated by Right Space LLC and headquartered in Cairo, Egypt. We help service businesses scale operations through AI automation, managed offshore teams, and custom software development.

> Your business never sleeps. Neither do we.

- Website: https://horusdesk.com
- Email: hello@horusdesk.com
- Office: 30B Asmaa Fahmy, Al Golf, Nasr City, Cairo Governorate 4451422, Egypt
- Social: https://www.linkedin.com/company/right-space-llc | https://www.facebook.com/horusdesk

## Services

### 1. Horus AI Agent — AI Receptionist
An AI-powered receptionist that handles website chat and email lead qualification and booking 24/7.

- Qualifies website visitors and books meetings automatically
- Supports 6 languages: English, Spanish, German, Dutch, French, Arabic
- Integrates with Gmail or Outlook
- Calendar booking via Calendly and Google Calendar
- Smart escalation when sentiment drops or questions get too complex
- Dedicated account manager handles setup and training
- Pricing: $499/month (or $299/month for the first 3 months); $3,999/year annual plan
- Includes 7,500 AI responses/month
- Extra 1,000 responses: $59 (non-expiring while subscribed)
- No long-term contract; cancel anytime
- Learn more: https://horusdesk.com/ai

### 2. Horus Managed Teams — Outsourced Support & Sales
Fully managed customer support and sales teams based in Cairo, Egypt.

- University-educated, English-fluent agents
- Recruitment, training, and full management included
- Dedicated account director + Cairo-based operations manager
- Quality analyst with call/chat reviews and weekly QA reports
- Custom SLAs per client
- Monthly performance reviews and live dashboard
- Agent replacement guarantee
- 24/7 coverage available
- Additional languages available: Spanish, French, German, Russian, and others
- Pricing: $10–$35/hour per agent
- Start with a 3-month proof of concept, then convert to a 1-year contract
- Scale up or down monthly with 30 days' notice
- Learn more: https://horusdesk.com/teams

### 3. Horus Software Studio — Custom Development
Custom web apps, mobile apps, and AI integrations built from scratch.

- Custom CRM & ERP systems
- Client portals & dashboards
- Mobile apps for field teams (iOS/Android)
- AI workflow automation: document parsing, predictive analytics, smart routing
- Native API integrations: QuickBooks, Stripe, Twilio, Google Calendar, internal systems
- Tech stack: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, React Native, Flutter, Node.js, Python, Go, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Redis, AWS, Vercel, Docker, CI/CD
- Pricing: Custom pricing based on scope
- Free system audit and technical blueprint before any payment
- Fixed deliverables, timeline, and price
- Clients own 100% of source code, data, and IP
- Optional monthly retainers or ad-hoc updates after launch
- Learn more: https://horusdesk.com/studio

## Target Customers

- Service businesses needing 24/7 lead capture (HVAC, home services, professional services)
- BPOs and call centers needing affordable, scalable support/sales agents
- Companies overwhelmed by SaaS subscription stacks who want custom-owned software
- Businesses with multilingual customers

## Why Horus Desk

- Fully managed — not DIY. We handle setup, training, and ongoing management.
- Low risk to start: free setup for AI, free audit/blueprint for Studio, 3-month proof of concept for Teams.
- No long-term lock-in: flexible monthly billing or short proof-of-concept terms.
- Own your assets: for Studio, clients keep source code, data, and IP with no vendor lock-in.
- Cost efficiency: Managed Teams cost a fraction of US-based hires; custom software avoids recurring SaaS fees.
- 24/7 operations: AI never sleeps; Cairo-based teams can cover any shift.
- Security & compliance: SOC 2 Type II via Supabase, GDPR-compliant, encrypted data, no customer data used to train AI models.

## Security & Compliance

- Data stored on Supabase (SOC 2 Type II, GDPR)
- Uses Anthropic Claude API under enterprise terms
- Encryption at rest and in transit
- No data selling; 30-day deletion available on request
- Security contact: security@horusdesk.com
- Details: https://horusdesk.com/security
